ʿAyn al Ghazaya
[
1
]
(
Arabic
:
الغزايا
) is a village in
Nalut District
in northwestern
Libya
. It lies on a crossroads on the
Wazzin
–
Nalut
road on the northern edge of the Tripolitanian Plateau in the
Nafusa Mountains
.
History
ʿAyn al Ghazaya was a
Gaddafi
stronghold during the
2011 Libyan civil war
, and provided a base for loyalist troops in the
2011 Nafusa Mountains Campaign
.
[
2
]
After the some 5,000 inhabitants were removed to
Tripoli
, it was captured by the rebel forces on 29 July 2011.
